title: Locational Pricing for Generative-AI Services via Token-Flow Market Clearing
summary: GenAI services are in an early yet fast expanding phase. Providers compete on model capability and service quality, while the underlying infrastructure remains expensive and heterogeneous across regions, workloads, and compute assets. If these services diffuse into routine daily use, the relevant engineering problem becomes not only better models but also efficient dispatch on a geographically distributed AI service infrastructure.
